purpose: Authoritative progress ledger for election-applicable precinct, ward, VTD, and equivalent local geometry acquisition and result crosswalks.

dispositionDefinitions.mapped: Reviewed election-applicable geometry and result crosswalk cover the state/DC scope intended for public delivery.
dispositionDefinitions.partial: A reviewed public subset exists, while documented jurisdictions or reporting units remain unavailable or blocked.
dispositionDefinitions.official_geometry_unavailable: Official-source review found no usable public election-applicable geometry; evidence and request path are recorded.
dispositionDefinitions.blocked: Candidate geometry exists but election vintage, identity, topology, reconciliation, or review gates prevent public delivery.

programStatusDefinitions.not_started: No precinct-GIS wave has reviewed this state/DC yet.
programStatusDefinitions.in_progress: A bounded source and crosswalk review is active.
programStatusDefinitions.reviewed: The current wave produced an evidence-backed disposition.

blockers: Public delivery remains null until separately authorized activation using certified SOS result rows.
states.nextAction: Resolve the listed election-vintage, source-coverage, and result-to-feature blockers; do not publish until every fail-closed eligibility gate passes.
